animatedplayer.configuration.title: Animated Player
animatedplayer.configuration.preview.hin: Hover an option to see what it does
animatedplayer.configuration.Enabled.too: Turn on and off the mod's animations on players.
animatedplayer.configuration.ApplyTo.too: Which players are animated: everyone, only you, or only the other players.
animatedplayer.configuration.AnimationDi: Other players farther than this are drawn as in vanilla, for performance.
animatedplayer.configuration.IdleAnimati: Relaxed stance and breathing when standing still.
animatedplayer.configuration.SwordAnimat: Dedicated attack animation when holding a sword. Off: the regular punch swing.
animatedplayer.configuration.SupermanFly: Superman pose when flying in creative mode.
animatedplayer.configuration.AnimateFace: Animate eyes, eyebrows and mouth, for the adapted skins.
animatedplayer.configuration.EyeMovement: Eyes follow where the player looks.
animatedplayer.configuration.EyebrowExpr: Eyebrows rise when fighting, sneaking or aiming.
animatedplayer.configuration.HungerEyebr: Eyebrows frown as the hunger bar empties.
animatedplayer.configuration.BreathlessM: Mouth opens to catch breath after sprinting or jumping.
animatedplayer.configuration.RoundedLimb: Rounded forearms, lower legs and chest, smooth elbows and knees.
animatedplayer.configuration.BetterHat.t: Render the hat layer as small cubes that follow the head shape.
animatedplayer.configuration.SkinLayers3: Render the second skin layer (jacket, sleeves, pants) in 3D, like the hat.
